pois.title: Vice City
pois.guide: Leonida's Miami-inspired city: beaches, nightlife and the heart of Jason and Lucia's story. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Leonida Keys
pois.guide: An island chain off the south coast, joined by long coastal highways. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Grassrivers
pois.guide: Everglades-style wetlands: airboats, wildlife and not much law. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Port Gellhorn
pois.guide: A run-down port town on Leonida's Gulf side. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Ambrosia
pois.guide: An inland industrial town built around its sugar refinery. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Mount Kalaga National Park
pois.guide: Leonida's wooded high country in the north, for hiking, hunting and off-roading. Pin position is approximate until the real map is out.

pois.title: Airboating
pois.guide: Race or cruise an airboat through the Grassrivers.

pois.title: Base jumping
pois.guide: Jump from Leonida's high points with a parachute.

pois.title: Billiards
pois.guide: Play pool in bars around Leonida.

pois.title: Jet skiing
pois.guide: Take a jet ski out on the water.

pois.title: Mini golf
pois.guide: Play a round of mini golf.

pois.title: Scuba diving
pois.guide: Dive offshore, including shipwrecks with treasure to find.

pois.title: Wyman's Classic Car Collection
pois.guide: Track down abandoned classic and project cars across Leonida for Wyman, a collector and local fixer, and restore them. Four of the cars are Ultimate Edition only.

_note: Only what Rockstar has confirmed: the six named regions and the eleven activities (Game Informer, 29 Sep 2026, plus Wyman's Classic Car Collection). Missions, collectibles and trophies arrive on release day; until then their placeholders stay out of the live app.
